testcase.name: Scenario: Commit a separator as the only custom panel item: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:755:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Commit a separator as the only custom panel item ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Part Tools custom panel list is empty ✔ When the user opens ribbon customization with All Commands selected ✔ And the user double-clicks "<Separator>" in the available list ✔ Then the custom panel list contains one separator ✔ When the user clicks OK ✔ Then no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon ✔ When the user reopens ribbon customization ✔ Then the Part Tools custom panel list contains one separator ✔ When the user double-clicks the separator in the custom panel list ✔ And the user clicks OK ✔ Then no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon
